title: TeleClaude MCP Registry
description: TeleClaude-owned lazy MCP registry. Shared entries live in teleclaude-mcp.jsonc and machine-local overrides live in teleclaude-mcp.local.jsonc.

servers.description: Configured MCP servers keyed by stable slug. Listing this catalog does not start a server.

transport.description: Transport kind. Remote HTTP/SSE servers are proxied through mcp-remote at runtime.

url.description: Remote MCP URL for http, sse, or streamable-http servers.

headers.description: Remote MCP headers. Use environment placeholders for secrets.

env.description: Environment templates exported only to the MCP child process.

enabled.description: Disabled entries remain configured but hidden from runtime catalog.

lazy.description: Lazy runtime behavior. Operation timeouts are fixed daemon defaults, not registry options.

enabled.description: Lazy runtime is the default managed-server mode.

idleTtlSec.description: Idle lease lifetime before runtime cleanup.

concurrency.description: Serialized is the safe default for stdio MCP pipes.

nativePublish.description: Compatibility opt-in for publishing this server to native agent MCP config.
